class.name: SpineTransformConstraint
class.brief_description: Stores the current pose for a transform constraint.
class.description: Stores the current pose for a transform constraint. A transform constraint adjusts the world transform of the constrained bones to match that of the target bone. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-transform-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this transform constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_data
method.description: The transform constraint's setup pose data.

method.name: get_mix_rotate
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained rotation.

method.name: get_mix_scale_x
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained scale X.

method.name: get_mix_scale_y
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained scale X.

method.name: get_mix_shear_y
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained shear Y.

method.name: get_mix_x
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation X.

method.name: get_mix_y
method.description: A percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation Y.

method.name: get_target
method.description: The target bone whose world transform will be copied to the constrained bones.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether this transform constraint is active. When inactive, the constraint is not applied.

method.name: set_active
method.description: Sets whether this transform constraint is active. When inactive, the constraint is not applied.

method.name: set_mix_rotate
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained rotation.

method.name: set_mix_scale_x
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained scale X.

method.name: set_mix_scale_y
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained scale Y.

method.name: set_mix_shear_y
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained shear Y.

method.name: set_mix_x
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained translation X.

method.name: set_mix_y
method.description: Sets the mix percentage between constrained and unconstrained translation Y.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Sets the target bone whose world transform is copied to constrained bones.

method.name: update
method.description: Applies the transform constraint so constrained bones match the target bone transform.
